name: Correction
overview: Scripture presents correction as a vital means of spiritual growth and wisdom, portraying instruction as a guiding light and a path to life. Loving instruction is equated with loving knowledge, while rejecting reproof is described as foolish and harmful to one's soul. Though rebuking the wicked may bring personal discomfort, timely correction is an expression of love and care, especially in the context of discipline. Embracing correction leads to understanding and maturity, underscoring its essential role in the believer's walk.
